definition: Establish chain correspondence, derive residue correspondences, compute a rigid-body superposition, and report TM-score-style normalized similarity together with RMSD and coverage.
assumptions: Only pairwise comparison between 7xg4 and 6n40 is required.
In absence of Foldseek-Multimer/US-align executable, a lightweight reproducible approximation can be implemented from PDB coordinates and sequences.
Because 6n40 has one chain and 7xg4 is multichain, chain-level correspondence can be represented as best-matching query chain(s) to target chain A plus a concatenated multichain comparison.
invariants: Use C-alpha coordinates for residue-level structural scoring.
Report explicit rotation matrix and translation vector.
Provide TM-score-style metric normalized by chain/query/target lengths as stated in report.
Mark deviations from exact Foldseek-Multimer or US-align behavior explicitly.
non_negotiable_steps: Parse structures reproducibly from local PDB files.
Compute structural superposition on aligned residues.
